Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O03
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/operations engineer with institutional operator
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: Catalog/blob loss cannot force recovery to trust stale permissions or credentials.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Design and implement an independently durable authority journal/checkpoint with sequence/completeness and authenticity verification, including memberships, stewardship and principal disablement; specify restrictive-change acknowledgment and replication-failure behavior.
2. Schedule verified off-host catalog/blob backups and rehearse restore with the source database unavailable; reconcile current policy, invalidate old credentials/sessions/leases and remain closed when evidence is incomplete.
3. Measure backup age/RPO and catalog/API versus full-blob-loss RTO; retain verifiable backup and recovery receipts. A digest or copy on the original host alone is insufficient.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.

Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
